collector_host_deployment_step.explanation: deploy/collector/docker-compose.yml bind-mounts ./fetch-policy.json:/app/fetch-policy.json:ro into collector-worker from WorkingDirectory=/opt/pantheon-collector. Copying the updated fetch-policy.json to /opt/pantheon-collector/fetch-policy.json on the collector host updates the mounted policy file (and its policy_hash, which also resets any prior consecutive_blocks state in collector-state.json). No host access is performed by this task.
collector_host_deployment_step.host_apply_command: sudo cp deploy/collector/fetch-policy.json /opt/pantheon-collector/fetch-policy.json && cd /opt/pantheon-collector && sudo docker compose run --rm collector-worker --policy-file /app/fetch-policy.json validate-config
collector_host_deployment_step.host_readback_command: cd /opt/pantheon-collector && sudo docker compose run --rm --entrypoint python3 collector-worker -c 'import json; from collector_stack.config import load_collector_config; p = load_collector_config("/app/fetch-policy.json").get_source("collector-news-rss"); print(json.dumps({"source_id": p.source_id, "policy_hash": p.policy_hash, "routes": p.raw_config["routes"], "served_categories": p.raw_config["served_categories"], "dropped_routes": p.raw_config["dropped_routes"], "max_requests_per_run": p.max_requests_per_run, "cadence_seconds": p.cadence_seconds, "min_interval_seconds": p.min_interval_seconds}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))'

residual_findings_outside_scope.defect: deploy/collector/collector_stack/pollers.py is outside this task's declared artifacts contract. In pollers.py:940, RssHubNewsPoller.collect defaults to routes: Sequence[str] = ("/cna/aall",) instead of reading tuple(self.policy.raw_config.get("routes") or ()) when routes is not passed, and RssHubNewsPoller.VERIFIED_ROUTES (pollers.py:902-910) still lists the old five routes. Because CollectorRunner.run_source("collector-news-rss") calls collector.collect(fetched_at=finished_iso) without passing routes in collect_kwargs, scheduled CLI runs (collector_stack run --source collector-news-rss) will continue requesting /cna/aall until a follow-up task updates RssHubNewsPoller.collect in deploy/collector/collector_stack/pollers.py to default routes from self.policy.raw_config["routes"] and rebuilds the collector-worker image on the collector host.
residual_findings_outside_scope.recommended_action: Attach to RC2 in docs/operations/problem-register.md and open a follow-up task scoping deploy/collector/collector_stack/pollers.py to default RssHubNewsPoller.collect routes from self.policy.raw_config.get("routes"), update VERIFIED_ROUTES, and isolate per-route fetch failures.

residual_findings_outside_scope.defect: When verified live against the pinned RSSHub container diygod/rsshub:chromium-bundled-2026-11-01, /cna/aie, /cna/asc, /udn/news/breakingnews/6, and /udn/news/breakingnews/11 return HTTP 200 valid RSS XML, whereas /chinatimes/money returns HTTP 503 due to an upstream RSSHub URL concatenation bug in /app/dist/chinatimes-BOLqovDF.mjs (https://www.chinatimes.comhttps//www.chinatimes.com/...) and /cw/master/8 returns HTTP 503 due to upstream www.cw.com.tw returning HTTP 403 to non-browser requests. Because ScraplingHttpFetcher raises FetchAccessBlockedError on HTTP 503/403, wiring RssHubNewsPoller.collect to iterate all policy routes without per-route failure isolation (or without restricting active routes to the HTTP-200-verified CNA/UDN routes) would cause a 503 on chinatimes/cw to abort and auto-pause the entire collector-news-rss run.
residual_findings_outside_scope.recommended_action: In the follow-up pollers.py task, isolate per-route HTTP errors in RssHubNewsPoller.collect (or keep only the HTTP-200-verified CNA and UDN routes active in routes while moving /chinatimes/money and /cw/master/8 to disabled/dropped until upstream RSSHub is updated).
